body:
Shruman Assassin
CR 8

A death angel appears with a humanoid form with stark white skin and a cap-like head. Its eyes gleam with deadly intent as it raises a crossbow.

XP 4,800
Death angel shruman rogue 5/assassin 4
NE Medium plant (fungus, humanoid)
Init +8; Senses Low-light vision; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 15, flat-footed 16 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 armor)
hp 65 (9 HD; 5d8+4d8+18)
Fort +5, Ref +12, Will +5; Immune mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep effects, stunning; DR 5/slashing

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 short sword +12/+7 (1d6+3/19-20 plus poison) or dagger +11/+6 (1d4+2/19-20 plus poison)
Ranged hand crossbow +11 (1d4/19-20 plus poison)
Special Attacks death attack (DC 18), poison use, sneak attack +5d6, toxic touch 1/day

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 20, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +6; CMB +8, CMD 24
Feats Deadly Aim, Death Angel’s Toxic Mastery, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse
Skills crobatics +17, Bluff +12, Climb +14, Craft (alchemy) +14, Diplomacy +12, Disable Device +17, Disguise +12, Escape Artist +17, Intimidate +12, Knowledge (local) +14, Perception +14, Sense Motive +13, Sleight of Hand +17, Stealth +21, Use Magic Device +12
Languages Common, Elven, Undercommon
SQ evasion, rogue talents (combat trick, fast stealth), trapfinding +2, uncanny dodge
Gear +1 mithral shirt, +1 short sword, dagger, hand crossbow with 20 bolts, cloak of resistance +1, potion of invisibility, antitoxin (2), thieves’ tools

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Deadly Touch (Su)

Once per day as a standard action, the Shruman assassin can make a melee touch attack that deals 1d4+4 poison damage. The target must also succeed on a Fortitude save (DC 16) or be sickened for 1d4 rounds.

Deathly Aura (Su)

Once per day, the Shruman assassin can activate an aura of dread for 1 minute. Enemies within 10 feet must succeed on a Will save (DC 14) or be shaken for 1d4 rounds.

Poison Use

The Shruman assassin never risks accidentally poisoning himself when applying poison to a weapon.

ECOLOGY

Environment any forest
Organization Solitary
Treasure standard

The Shruman assassin prefers to strike from the shadows, using his Stealth skill to remain undetected until the perfect moment. He often begins an encounter by activating his Deathly Aura to unnerve his targets, then uses his hand crossbow to deliver a poisoned bolt with a sneak attack. In melee, he relies on his short sword, attempting to position himself for sneak attacks whenever possible. If cornered, he uses his Deadly Touch ability to sicken a powerful opponent before attempting to escape using Acrobatics or Stealth.
